prompt: 测一下收益型标题对注册转化率的影响

experiment.name: landing-cta-headline-v1
experiment.hypothesis: 把落地页主标题+CTA 从功能描述型改为收益承诺型，将使注册转化率从约 10% 提升到至少 13%

control.headline: Organize your team's work in one place

treatment.headline: Ship projects twice as fast — start today

defaultsUsed.defaultValue: control: “Organize your team's work in one place” / “Start free trial”; treatment: “Ship projects twice as fast — start today” / “Get started free”
defaultsUsed.note: Prompt states no explicit copy; using the documented default copy from design.md §2.5. Quote copy in the prompt to override, e.g. control「…」treatment「…」.
Prompt states no split; defaulting to an even 50/50 split.
Prompt states no sample size; 1000/group leaves margin over the ≈686/group required for α=0.05, power=0.8, p1=0.10, p2=0.15 (design.md §3).
